lessons.title: GROUP BY HAVING
lessons.description: Group orders by customer_id. Select customer_id and COUNT(*) as order_count, and keep groups where order_count is greater than 1. The test checks that the rows are (1, 3) and (2, 2).
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: count orders per customer, keeping only customers with more than one order
SELECT customer_id, 0 AS order_count FROM orders WHERE 0 GROUP BY customer_id;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING order_count > 1;
